look: Tide Wisp, a F-rank GKOM variant from the Tide Wisps family: drifting bubble of lake water with a grey orb inside. Family anatomy: living water: wisps, water maidens and serpents of black lake water. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: only a few small GKOM crystal growths (two or three finger-length points); most of its natural skin, hide or surface is exposed; the crystals are pearl-white tide crystal. A marble-sized GKOM core orb, murky grey, dim faint pulse, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, tiny subtle ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
